sb_prompt: WHAT DO YOU THINK ABOUT CURRENT OR RECENT AMERICAN ACTIONS IN LATIN AMERICA
turns: Yeah, actually, that whole US intervention thing in Venezuela is crazy to me. Like, they keep interfering everywhere, but last week I served this table in Miami where the guy was actually from there, and he told me about how the oil is being shipped out now. It's wild how politics ends up on your server's tip sheet, right?
Yeah, it's weird, but honestly I just never really looked too close at the maps until I got my first job in the states and someone asked me where the main line ran.

Yeah, I mean, he was basically complaining that the prices here are astronomical compared to what he used to pay, and I totally get why he'd be upset, but then the guy behind me started bragging about how he actually owns a little condo in Cartagena, which just made it all feel... complicated.

Yeah, the condo part is the weirdest thing. I worked on a pipe burst in Cartagena two years ago and the guy basically didn't care about politics at all, just wanted the water pressure fixed, but then he asked me about the US sanctions and it was like he was talking in code or something.
I mean, honestly, I don't even know if that's him talking in code or if he just doesn't care enough to make it sound complicated.
I guess he just wanted to know if the pipes were safe from the sanctions or something, which is a weird question for a plumber to ask about water pressure.

Yeah, that makes sense, I mean if the pipes break under sanctions it's kinda scary but then the guy behind me started talking about how the water tastes weird here and I was like wait, isn't that just chlorine?
Yeah, that's actually what I was thinking too, just didn't know how to ask.
Yeah, that's exactly what I was thinking, chlorine makes everything taste kinda funny but I'm just used to it by now.
Yeah, probably just the water source, honestly.
Yeah, it's just weird because usually people in Miami act like it's an adventure, but when you're actually talking to them it feels like you're just waiting for a bus that's never gonna come.
Yeah, honestly it feels like waiting in line at a restaurant that keeps getting understaffed.
Yeah, but then you realize the whole line moves at the same speed whether you're standing at the register or the water heater, so it really doesn't matter where you work.
Yeah, but then again, nobody really cares about the line moving if the water is actually cold or if the tip is good.
Yeah, but if the line moves fast enough, I don't even notice if the water is cold or the tip is bad.
Yeah, that's basically what it's like sometimes.
Yeah, but honestly, if the water is just warm enough to wash dishes with, who cares if the tips are low?
Yeah, I guess if the water runs hot enough, nobody really minds what the bill looks like.
Yeah, but then again, if the water is freezing, nobody wants to stay in the line no matter how good the tips are.
Yeah, but then again, nobody cares about the water temperature if they can't afford to stay in the house long enough to notice.
Yeah, but I still think the water in Miami tastes better than the stuff back home, so maybe that's something we can't control.
Yeah, you're right, we can't control the source but we can usually fix the flow.
Yeah, but I still feel like the flow is kind of rigged if you don't know who's pulling the strings in the kitchen.
Yeah, but I guess if you don't know who owns the pressure valve, the whole system just feels rigged to fail anyway.
Yeah, that's the thing, if you don't know who owns the valve, it feels like you're just waiting for a burst pipe in a house you can't afford anyway.
Yeah, that's basically the thing, nobody owns the valve but everyone waits for it to break anyway.
Yeah, maybe that's why I just want to go home and make my own coffee.
Yeah, maybe I should just bring my own tools next time.
Yeah, I guess you're right, I'll just try to make my own coffee.
Yeah, maybe I'll just bring my own tools next time.
Yeah, I'll just try to make my own coffee.
Yeah, maybe that's the best we can hope for.
Yeah, maybe that's the best we can hope for.
Yeah, I guess that's the best we can hope for.
Yeah, maybe we should both just hang up now and go home.
